figures.alt: Illustration of a boy in a yellow raincoat and rain boots with an umbrella, walking past a puddle on a rainy street.
figures.caption: We pick rain gear because of what it does: it keeps water out.

figures.alt: Photo of ice cubes melting in a glass bowl with a puddle of water, and a pat of butter softening in a pan.
figures.caption: Warming melts ice and butter. These changes can be undone by cooling.

figures.alt: Table drawn with colored dots. Plastic wrap: dry, dry, dry. Foil: dry, dry, dry. Cloth: damp, wet, wet. Paper: wet, wet, wet.
figures.caption: Rainproof Note backup data. Plastic wrap and foil stayed dry all 3 tries; cloth got damp then wet; paper was wet every time.
